#Removing unnecessary columns 



CD <- Shark %>%
  select(
    -Object.of.bite,
    -Shark.captured,
    -Clothing.coverage,
    -Direction.first.strike,
    -Basis.for.length,
    -Wind.condition,
    -Depth.of.incident.m,
    -Fin.colour,
    -Total.water.depth.m,
    -Spring.or.neap.tide,
    -`People <3m`,
    -Victim.aware.of.shark,
    -Present.at.time.of.bite,
    -Weather.condition,
    -Victim.clothing,
    -Shark.identification.source,
    -Commercial.dive.activity,
    -Dominant.clothing.colour,
    -Other.clothing.colour,
    -Clothing.pattern,
    -...60,
    -Reference,
    -Deterrent.brand.and.type,
    -Personal.protective.device,
    -Distance.to.shore.m,
    -Water.visability.m,
    -Teeth.recovered,
    -Time.in.water.min,
    -Time.of.incident,
    -`People 3-15m`
  )


CD <- CD %>% 
  filter(Incident.year >= 2020, Incident.year <= 2025)

names(CD)
##  [1] "UIN"                         "Incident.month"             
##  [3] "Incident.year"               "Victim.injury"              
##  [5] "State"                       "Location"                   
##  [7] "Latitude"                    "Longitude"                  
##  [9] "Site.category"               "Site.category.comment"      
## [11] "Shark.common.name"           "Shark.scientific.name"      
## [13] "Shark.identification.method" "Shark.length.m"             
## [15] "Provoked/unprovoked"         "Provocative.act"            
## [17] "No.sharks"                   "Victim.activity"            
## [19] "Fish.speared?"               "Shark.behaviour"            
## [21] "Injury.location"             "Injury.severity"            
## [23] "Victim.gender"               "Victim.age"                 
## [25] "Diversionary.action.taken"   "Diversionary.action.outcome"
## [27] "Water.temperature.°C"        "Tidal.cycle"                
## [29] "Air.temperature.°C"          "Data.source"
CD <- CD %>%
  select(
    -`Fish.speared?`,
    -Tidal.cycle,
    -Diversionary.action.taken,
    -Diversionary.action.outcome,
    -`Air.temperature.°C`,
    -Victim.age,
    -Data.source,
    -`Water.temperature.°C`,
    -Victim.activity,
    -Shark.behaviour
  )

#Creating a table for injuries
table(CD$Victim.injury, useNA = "ifany")
## 
##     fatal   injured    injury uninjured   unknown 
##        23        96         1        41         1
shark_attack <- CD %>%
  count(
    Incident.year,
    Shark.common.name,
    Victim.injury,
    name = "Attacks"
  )

head(shark_attack)
## # A tibble: 6 × 4
##   Incident.year Shark.common.name   Victim.injury Attacks
##           <dbl> <chr>               <chr>           <int>
## 1          2020 bronze whaler shark uninjured           3
## 2          2020 bull shark          fatal               1
## 3          2020 bull shark          injured             2
## 4          2020 bull shark          uninjured           3
## 5          2020 dusky shark         uninjured           1
## 6          2020 hammerhead shark    uninjured           1
colnames(shark_attack)
## [1] "Incident.year"     "Shark.common.name" "Victim.injury"    
## [4] "Attacks"
 #Plotting Incident graph

ggplot(shark_attack,aes(x=Incident.year, 
                      y= Attacks,
                      fill = Victim.injury)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~Shark.common.name) +
  labs(
    title = "Shark Incidents by Species and Injury Severity",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Incidents",
    fill = "Injury Severity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text.x = element_text(size=4)
  )

#Renaming columnns (new name then old name)
shark_attack<- shark_attack %>%
  rename(
    Shark_common_name =  Shark.common.name,
    Outcome = Victim.injury,
    Incident_year = Incident.year
  )

#Graph of total attacks 2015-2025

                        y= Attacks,
                        fill = Outcome)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~Shark_common_name) +

    title = "Total species count of shark",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Incidents",

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x =  element_text(size= 12 ,angle = 45, hjust = 1 ),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size=8, face = "bold"),
   plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
   axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),
  )

#Unique value assign each column
unique(Meta$State)
## [1] "NSW" "QLD" "SA"  "WA"  "TAS" "VIC" "NT"  "Qld"
Meta <- Meta %>%
  mutate(
    State = ifelse(State == "Qld", "QLD", State)
  )

  mutate(State = trimws(State)) %>%
  count(State, name = "Attacks")

print(state_attacks)

  arrange(desc(Attacks))

#GGplot puts categories in Alphabetical order
#
ST<- state_attacks%>%
  mutate(State = factor(State, levels = State))
#Plotting state data

ggplot(ST,
       aes(x = reorder(State, Attacks),
           y = 1,
           fill = Attacks)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "lightblue",
    high = "darkred"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Shark Incidents by State",
    x = "State",
    y = "Incidents",
    fill = "Frequency of incidents"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

Meta <- Meta %>%
  mutate(
    Shark.common.name = case_when(
      is.na(Shark.common.name) ~ "Unknown",
      Shark.common.name %in% c("N/A", "unknown", "UNKNOWN") ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ Shark.common.name
    )
  )


species_attacks <- Meta %>%
  mutate(Shark.common.name = trimws(Shark.common.name)) %>%
  count(Shark.common.name, name = "Attacks")

aus_states <- ozmaps:: ozmap_states


names(aus_states)
## [1] "NAME"     "geometry"
st_geometry_type(aus_states)
## [1] MULTIPOLYGON MULTIPOLYGON MULTIPOLYGON MULTIPOLYGON MULTIPOLYGON
## [6] MULTIPOLYGON MULTIPOLYGON MULTIPOLYGON MULTIPOLYGON
## 18 Levels: GEOMETRY POINT LINESTRING POLYGON MULTIPOINT ... TRIANGLE
unique(aus_states$NAME)
## [1] "New South Wales"              "Victoria"                    
## [3] "Queensland"                   "South Australia"             
## [5] "Western Australia"            "Tasmania"                    
## [7] "Northern Territory"           "Australian Capital Territory"
## [9] "Other Territories"
ggplot(aus_states) + geom_sf(fill= "lightblue", colour = "white")+
  theme_minimal()

#Cleaner version with colour depending on state

aus_states_clean <- aus_states %>%
  group_by(NAME) %>%
  summarise(geometry = st_union (geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
              st_as_sf()
            

ggplot(aus_states_clean) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = NAME), colour = "white",)+
  theme_minimal()+
    labs(fill= "STATE/Territory")

species_attacks <- Meta %>%
  count(Shark.common.name, name = "Attacks") %>%
  arrange(desc(Attacks))
#Add the state data with long and lat 
Gmap <- Meta %>%
  select(State, Longitude, Latitude, everything()) 
 

colnames(Meta)

IP <- st_as_sf(
  Gmap, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

Gmap2 <- Gmap %>%
  mutate(
    Longitude = as.numeric(Longitude),
    Latitude = as.numeric(Latitude)
  ) %>%
  select(State,Longitude,Latitude,everything()
  )


Gmap2 <- Gmap %>%
  mutate(
    Longitude = parse_number(as.character(Longitude)),
    Latitude = parse_number(as.character(Latitude)),
    Latitude = -abs(Latitude)
  )

Gmap3 <- st_as_sf(
  Gmap2, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

aus_states_clean <- st_transform(aus_states_clean, 4326)

ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data = aus_states_clean, 
           ,fill = "#E8D8B0", colour = "#333333") +
  geom_sf(data = Gmap3, aes(colour = State)
          , size = 3, alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal()
